title: ReferenceBundle v1
description: Frozen app-consumer contract. It contains user-consumable guidance only: no image data, URI, path, provider metadata, credentials, keypoints, or live Pose data.

reference_id.description: Opaque identifier only; never a URI, image path, account, device, or location identifier.

pose_template.description: Textual reference-derived pose intent only. It is not a keypoint set, skeleton coordinate payload, biometric result, or Pose-provider output.

version.description: Frozen payload version. Unknown versions must be rejected rather than guessed or partially rendered.

plainText240.description: Plain single-line text. Markdown and newlines are not part of the v1 wire contract.
